title: Is Agentic AI Ready for Real-World Hardware Engineering? A Deep Dive with Phoenix-bench
abstract: arXiv:2605.15226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We ask whether agentic AI systems built for software engineering transfer to realistic hardware engineering. Existing hardware LLM benchmarks isolate sub-tasks but none jointly requires repository navigation, hierarchy-aware localization, Electronic Design Automation (EDA) executable verification, and maintenance-style patching. We introduce \textbf{Phoenix-bench}, a synchronized corpus of 511 verified Verilator instances from 114 GitHub repositories, each shipped with the developer patch, design-flow labels, fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass testbenches, and a Docker-pinned EDA environment so resolved-rate differences reflect agent behavior rather than toolchain availability. Using Phoenix-bench we run a uniform evaluation of four commercial agents and eight open-source agentic structures across four LLM backbones, plus two diagnostic interventions (file-level oracle localization and one round of testbench-log feedback). translated_title: 智能体AI是否已为真实世界的硬件工程做好准备？基于Phoenix-bench的深入探究
translated_abstract: 我们探讨为软件工程构建的智能体AI系统能否迁移到真实的硬件工程场景中。现有的硬件LLM基准测试均只孤立地考察子任务，没有一个能够同时要求仓库导航、层次感知的定位、电子设计自动化（EDA）可执行验证以及维护式补丁修改。我们提出了Phoenix-bench——一个包含来自114个GitHub仓库的511个经过验证的Verilator实例的同步语料库，每个实例都附带开发者补丁、设计流程标签、失败转通过（fail-to-pass）与通过转保持（pass-to-pass）测试平台，以及由Docker固定的EDA环境，从而使解决率差异能够反映智能体自身的行为而非工具链的可用性。借助Phoenix-bench，我们对四个商业智能体和八种开源智能体结构在四个LLM骨干模型上进行了统一评估，并加入两种诊断性干预（文件级oracle定位和一轮测试平台日志反馈）。三个fin……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Phoenix-bench——首个同时要求仓库导航、层次感知定位、EDA可执行验证和维护式补丁的硬件工程智能体基准，包含511个经核实的Verilator实例，并系统评估了商业与开源智能体在真实硬件工程任务上的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Phoenix-bench, the first hardware-engineering agent benchmark that jointly requires repository navigation, hierarchy-aware localization, EDA executable verification, and maintenance-style patching with 511 verified Verilator instances, and systematically evaluates commercial and open-source agents on realistic hardware engineering tasks.
